purpose: pre-registration of the evaluation, so the forward test cannot be moved after the data arrives

vintage.rule: the monthly judgment run may change live scores; every endpoint below grades the frozen vintage

primary.metric: tier spread, t1 mean forward return minus exit mean forward return, from the frozen vintage

secondary.metric: Spearman information coefficient, frozen score vs forward return
equal-weight investable basket vs S&P 500 total return
secondary.success: stated either way; the experiment is allowed to fail

secondary.metric: convergence hypothesis, local form: median counterforce access across the imbalance map
secondary.success: median access rises while pressure components are held to re-researched evidence

universe.metric: Spearman information coefficient, frozen first-screen score vs forward return, across every priced name in the universe vintage (about 9,982 of 15,797)
universe.success: greater than 0.03; the screen's judgment of the whole universe must carry information, not only its top 53

universe.metric: advanced-minus-cut spread: mean forward return of stages R, 3 and 4 minus stages 0 and 2, size-unweighted
universe.success: stated either way; a negative spread is evidence against the screen and will be published as such

pending_external.metric: attribution of basket returns to size, value, quality and momentum factors (French library or ETF proxies)
pending_external.status: data source unreachable from the build environment; registered so it cannot be quietly dropped
pending_external.success: the thesis survives only if alpha remains after factor loadings

discipline: no endpoint, horizon, or success threshold changes after registration; corrections require a new registration that supersedes and preserves this one
weights and tier bands stay frozen for the evaluation window; the derivation layer may keep correcting labels, since labels obey measurements
one look per week when the price track updates; no intraweek peeking
the momentum contamination check is reported alongside every forward reading

supersedes.reason: adds universe-level endpoints and registers the pending external factor test; every v1 endpoint is preserved unchanged
